description: Plan home repair with Miller Remodeling in Idaho’s Treasure Valley. Discuss your goals, layout and selections before construction.
heading: Take care of the home you have.
intro: Thoughtful home repairs, with the same care we bring to a larger remodel.

sections.heading: Fix the detail. Understand the cause.
paragraphs: Tell us what needs attention and how it affects your home. We discuss the repair, the surrounding work, and the right next step.

sections.heading: A clear scope comes first.
paragraphs: Good repairs start with understanding the problem. Share your project so we can talk through the work and whether it is a fit.

faqs.question: How do I start a take care of the home you have project?
faqs.answer: Start by sharing your goals, location and photos through the project inquiry. Erik reviews the brief so the first conversation can focus on what needs to change.

faqs.question: Are design and selections part of the planning phase?
faqs.answer: Yes. The paid design phase covers floorplans, selections and a 3D walkthrough before construction. Discuss the deliverables for your particular scope during consultation.
